answer_first.title: Answer in your own words
answer_first.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} the box and write your answer, the way you’d say it out loud. One line is enough; up to 1000 characters.
answer_first.wait: Write something (up to 1000 characters) to continue.

answer_more.title: One more question
answer_more.body: Answer this one the same way. You can change your answers until you send.
answer_more.wait: Write something (up to 1000 characters) to continue.

no_questions.title: No questions for this job
no_questions.body: This employer asks nothing, so you only need to send your application.

later.title: No documents now
later.body: You don’t upload anything to apply. The employer asks for documents only if they want to hire you.

send.title: Send your application
send.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Send application. That is what applies; nothing is sent before it.
send.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Send application to finish.

sent.title: You applied!
sent.body: Your application shows Applied while the employer reviews it. When the employer writes to you, the message arrives on WhatsApp.

closed.title: This job closed
closed.body: The employer stopped taking applications for this job, so your application wasn’t sent. Other jobs are still open.

gate_name.title: Your name
gate_name.body: Employers need a few details before you can apply. Type your full name in Full name.

gate_skills.title: Your skills
gate_skills.body: Type what you can do in Skills (comma separated), with a comma between each one, like “framing, drywall”.
gate_skills.wait: Add at least one skill to continue.

gate_availability.title: When can you work?
gate_availability.body: Pick Full-time, Part-time, Weekends or Flexible in Availability.

gate_location.title: Where you live
gate_location.body: Type your city in Location, like “El Paso, TX”.

gate_years.title: Years of experience
gate_years.body: Optional. Type how many years you’ve worked in Years of experience, or leave it as it is.

gate_save.title: Save your profile
gate_save.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Save and apply. It saves your profile and opens your application; you send it on the next screen.
gate_save.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Save and apply to go on.

back.title: Need to stop?
back.body: Back to the job keeps what you typed while you stay on this page. To come back, {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Continue application.

worker_details.title: Details requested
worker_details.description: What to do when an employer wants to hire you.

request.title: An employer wants to hire you
request.body: They ask a few questions and some documents. It takes about 5 minutes, in three short steps.

saved.title: Saved documents are added for you
saved.body: Files you saved before count automatically: they show as Uploaded. You can replace any of them.

send.title: Check and finish
send.body: Check your answers, then tap Finish. The employer gets them right away.

guide.intro_title: Want a hand with your details?
guide.intro_body: {input, select, touch {We’ll show you each part, one at a time: what to answer, which files to add and where to tap Finish. About 5 minutes.} other {We’ll show you each part, one at a time: what to answer, which files to add and where to click Finish. About 5 minutes.}}

prompts.title: The employer’s questions
prompts.body: Answer this question in its box, in your own words. Up to 1000 characters.
prompts.wait: Write an answer (up to 1000 characters) to continue.

prompts_save.title: Save your answers
prompts_save.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Save and continue. Then come the details the employer asked for.
prompts_save.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Save and continue to go on.

overview.title: Three steps
overview.body: Details, Documents & certifications, then Check & finish. The bar shows what’s left. Some answers from your last application may already be filled in: check them as we go.
overview.wait: One moment: checking your saved files.

field_work_authorization.title: Can you work in the US?
field_work_authorization.body: Under “Authorized to work in the US?”, {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Yes or No.
field_work_authorization.body_optional: This one is optional. Under “Authorized to work in the US?”, {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Yes or No, or {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Skip to leave it out.
field_work_authorization.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Yes or No to continue.

field_date_available.title: When can you start?
field_date_available.body: In Date available, pick the first day you can start.
field_date_available.body_optional: This one is optional. In Date available, pick the first day you can start, or {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Skip to leave it out.

field_desired_pay.title: The pay you want
field_desired_pay.body: In Desired pay, type the amount in whole dollars, with no cents. Then pick Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly or Fixed (flat rate).
field_desired_pay.body_optional: This one is optional. In Desired pay, type the amount in whole dollars, with no cents, and pick how often; or {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Skip to leave it out.
field_desired_pay.wait: Type a whole-dollar amount to continue.

field_home_address.title: Your address
field_home_address.body: Type your street, your city, the 2-letter state (like TX) and the 5-digit ZIP code. The apartment box is optional.
field_home_address.body_optional: This one is optional. Type your street, city, 2-letter state (like TX) and 5-digit ZIP code, or {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Skip to leave it out.
field_home_address.wait: Fill in the street, city, 2-letter state and 5-digit ZIP to continue.

field_date_of_birth.title: Your date of birth
field_date_of_birth.body: In Date of birth, pick the day you were born.
field_date_of_birth.body_optional: This one is optional. In Date of birth, pick the day you were born, or {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Skip to leave it out.

field_emergency_contact.title: Who to call in an emergency
field_emergency_contact.body: Type the name and the phone number of someone to call if something happens at work.
field_emergency_contact.body_optional: This one is optional. Type the name and phone number of someone to call if something happens at work, or {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Skip to leave it out.
field_emergency_contact.wait: Type a name and a phone number to continue.

field_worked_here_before.title: Have you worked here before?
field_worked_here_before.body: Under “Worked here before?”, {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Yes or No. If you {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Yes, you can say when in the box that opens.
field_worked_here_before.body_optional: This one is optional. Under “Worked here before?”, {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Yes or No, or {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Skip to leave it out.
field_worked_here_before.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Yes or No to continue.

field_education.title: Your schooling
field_education.body: In Education, open the list and pick your school level. If you pick anything but None, also answer Yes or No to “Graduated?”.
field_education.body_optional: This one is optional. In Education, pick your school level from the list, or {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Skip to leave it out.
field_education.wait: Pick a school level to continue.

field_references.title: Your references
field_references.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Add reference, then type their name, how you know them and their phone number. Company is optional. You can add up to 3.
field_references.body_optional: This one is optional. {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Add reference and type their name, how you know them and their phone number, or {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Skip to leave it out.
field_references.wait: Add a reference with a name, a relationship and a phone number to continue.

field_work_history.title: Your past jobs
field_work_history.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Add previous job, then type the company and your job title. The other boxes are optional. You can add up to 3.
field_work_history.body_optional: This one is optional. {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Add previous job and type the company and your job title, or {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Skip to leave it out.
field_work_history.wait: Add a job with the company and your job title to continue.

field_military_service.title: Military service
field_military_service.body: Under Military service, {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Yes or No. If you {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Yes, the boxes that open are optional.
field_military_service.body_optional: This one is optional. Under Military service, {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Yes or No, or {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Skip to leave it out.
field_military_service.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Yes or No to continue.

details_continue.title: Save this step
details_continue.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Save and continue. If a question then says “This needs an answer”, fix it and {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} it again.
details_continue.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Save and continue to go on.

vault_retry.title: We can’t see your saved files
vault_retry.body: Checking your saved files failed, so every file shows as not uploaded. {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Try again.
vault_retry.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Try again to continue.

doc_notice_legacy.title: This one isn’t uploaded here
doc_notice_legacy.body: The employer may ask you for it in person. It doesn’t stop you from finishing.

doc_notice_unknown.title: We don’t know this requirement
doc_notice_unknown.body: Ask the employer what they need. It doesn’t stop you from finishing.

certification_doc.title: Your certification
certification_doc.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Add certification and pick a PDF or a photo (JPG or PNG). You can add up to 5. If it says Optional, you can go on without it.

certifications.title: A certification the employer needs
certifications.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Yes if you have it; with No you can’t continue. If it asks for proof, {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Upload new and pick a PDF or a photo.
certifications.wait: Answer Yes, with proof if it asks for it, to continue.

documents_continue.title: On to the last step
documents_continue.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Continue. If something is then marked in red, fix it and {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} it again.
documents_continue.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Continue to go on.

review_summary.title: Check what we’ll send
review_summary.body: Each question should say Answered or Skipped, and your documents are counted here.

review_missing.title: Something is still missing
review_missing.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} the link under the message to go back and fill it in. This guide ends here; you can finish on your own: come back to Check & finish and {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Finish.
review_missing.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} the link to go and fix it.

review_finish.title: Send it
review_finish.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Finish to send everything to the employer.
review_finish.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Finish to send.

complete.title: Done
complete.body: The employer has your details. We’ll let you know when they update your application. Back to my applications takes you to the rest.

doc_resume.saved_body: It shows Uploaded, so it counts automatically: nothing to do here. {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} View to check it, and Replace only if it’s the wrong file.
doc_resume.title: Add your resume
doc_resume.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Upload and pick your resume: a PDF or a photo (JPG or PNG). If it doesn’t go up, try again.
doc_resume.body_optional: This one is optional: you can go on without it. To add it, {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Upload and pick a PDF or a photo (JPG or PNG).

doc_driver_license.saved_title: Your driver’s license is already saved
doc_driver_license.saved_body: It shows Uploaded, so it counts automatically: nothing to do here. {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} View to check it, and Replace only if it’s the wrong file.
doc_driver_license.title: Add your driver’s license
doc_driver_license.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Upload and pick your driver’s license: a PDF or a photo (JPG or PNG). If it doesn’t go up, try again.
doc_driver_license.body_optional: This one is optional: you can go on without it. To add it, {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Upload and pick a PDF or a photo (JPG or PNG).
doc_driver_license.wait: Upload your driver’s license to continue.

doc_work_auth_doc.saved_title: Your work authorization document is already saved
doc_work_auth_doc.saved_body: It shows Uploaded, so it counts automatically: nothing to do here. {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} View to check it, and Replace only if it’s the wrong file.
doc_work_auth_doc.title: Add your work authorization document
doc_work_auth_doc.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Upload and pick your work authorization document: a PDF or a photo (JPG or PNG). If it doesn’t go up, try again.
doc_work_auth_doc.body_optional: This one is optional: you can go on without it. To add it, {input, select, touch {tap} other {click}} Upload and pick a PDF or a photo (JPG or PNG).
doc_work_auth_doc.wait: Upload your work authorization document to continue.

prompt_more.title: One more question
prompt_more.body: Answer this one the same way, in your own words.
prompt_more.wait: Write an answer (up to 1000 characters) to continue.

certification_optional.title: An optional certification
certification_optional.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Yes or No. It never stops you from finishing.

worker_profile.title: Your profile
worker_profile.description: What employers see, and your documents.

seen.title: What employers see
seen.body: When you apply, employers see your trade, skills, experience and availability, plus the answers you gave in your own words when you signed up. Those answers aren’t shown on this page.

documents.title: Add documents once
documents.body: Save your Resume, Driver's License or Work Authorization Document here. They’re used again on every application, so you don’t upload them twice. Certifications aren’t uploaded here.

edit.title: Keep it up to date
edit.body: Tap Edit any time to change your name, trade, skills, availability, years of experience, location, cities, About you or certifications.

scene.quote: “I finish slabs and driveways and set my own forms.”
scene.reused: A photo of the card is fine. Used again on every application.

guide.intro_title: Want a hand with your profile?
guide.intro_body: {input, select, touch {We’ll show you each part, one at a time: what to tap, what to pick and what to type. About 2 minutes.} other {We’ll show you each part, one at a time: what to click, what to pick and what to type. About 2 minutes.}}

edit.title: Open the form
edit.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Edit to open the form with your details.
edit.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Edit to continue.

name.title: Your name
name.body: Type your full name in Full name.

trade.title: Pick your trade
trade.body: Open the Trade list and pick the one you do most. If yours isn’t there, pick Other. Already right? {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Next.

trade_other.title: Type your trade
trade_other.body: You picked Other, so a box appeared. Type your trade in Your trade, like “Welder”, in 2 to 60 characters.

skills.title: List your skills
skills.body: Type what you can do in Skills, with a comma between each one, like “framing, drywall, trim”.
skills.wait: Add at least one skill to continue.

availability.title: When can you work?
availability.body: Pick Full-time, Part-time, Weekends or Flexible in Availability. If you never set it, it’s empty now, and you need to pick one to save.

years.title: Years of experience
years.body: Optional. Type how many years you’ve worked, as a whole number from 0 to 80, or leave it as it is.
years.wait: Use a whole number from 0 to 80, or leave it empty, to continue.

location.title: Your location
location.body: Start typing your city or ZIP in Location, then pick your city from the list. A city you type but don’t pick is saved as text only, without its spot on the map.

cities.title: Cities where you want to work
cities.body: Optional. Type a city or ZIP under Cities where you want to find work, then pick it from the list to add it. Typing alone doesn’t add a city. You can add up to 10.

documents.title: Your documents
documents.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Upload to add a Resume, Driver's License or Work Authorization Document, or Replace to change one. Use a PDF, JPG or PNG. Each one holds one file and is saved as soon as it uploads. Certifications aren’t uploaded here.

save.title: Save your changes
save.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Save. If “Please add:” shows instead, end the guide and fill in what it names.
save.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Save to finish.

done.title: Profile saved
done.body: Your changes are saved. {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Edit any time to change them again.

employer_welcome.title: How Jale works
employer_welcome.description: From posting a job to hiring, in five steps.

post.title: Post a job in 3 steps
post.body: Add the title, trade, city and how many workers you need. Everything else is optional.

share.title: Share your job link
share.body: Turn on the share link, then send it to your crew leads or print the QR code.

apply.title: Workers apply on WhatsApp or the web
apply.body: Everyone who applies lands in Applicants, with what they told us about their work.

review.title: Review and message
review.body: Open an applicant to see their trade, experience and trust score. Your messages reach them on WhatsApp.

hire.title: Request details, then hire
hire.body: When you want to hire someone, request their details. Once they are complete, mark them hired.

scenes.crew: Send it to your crew leads
scenes.plan_line: {limit, plural, =0 {Your plan does not include active jobs} one {Your plan: up to # active job} other {Your plan: up to # active jobs}}

employer_post_job.title: Posting a job
employer_post_job.description: The three steps and the 4 required fields.

steps.title: Three short steps
steps.body: The basics, pay and schedule, then questions for applicants. Only 4 things are required: title, trade, city and workers needed.

city.title: Pick the city from the list
city.body: Start typing and tap a match. A city that is typed but not picked from the list does not count.

shifts.title: Choose the shifts
shifts.body: Pick Day, Evening, Night or Overnight, as many as apply. Exact times are optional; you can agree on hours with the worker.

questions.title: Questions come in two parts
questions.body: A few quick questions when they apply, and the rest only after you request their details. Once someone applies, neither part can change.

guide.intro_title: Want a hand posting this job?
guide.intro_body: {input, select, touch {We’ll show you each field, one at a time: what to tap, what to pick and what to type. About 2 minutes.} other {We’ll show you each field, one at a time: what to click, what to pick and what to type. About 2 minutes.}}

title.title: Name the job
title.body: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} the Job Title box and type the job title, like “Forklift operator” or “Concrete finisher”.

city.title: Pick the city from the list
city.body: {input, select, touch {Start typing the city in Location, then tap it in the list.} other {Start typing the city in Location, then click it in the list.}} A city you type but don’t pick doesn’t count.
city.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} a city in the list to continue.

trade.title: Pick the trade
trade.body: Open the Trade list and choose the trade. Workers with that trade are matched to your job. If it isn’t there, pick Other.

trade_other.title: Type the trade
trade_other.body: You picked Other, so a new box appeared. Type the trade there, like “Welder”.

next.title: That’s all this screen needs
next.body: Title, city and trade are the required fields here; job type and description are optional. {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Next to go on to pay and schedule.
next.wait: {input, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} Next to continue.

workers.title: How many workers?
workers.body: Type how many people you need on site. It starts at 1.

employer_applicants.title: Your applicants
employer_applicants.description: Trust scores, statuses and how to hire.

first_look.title: What you see first
first_look.body: Each applicant shows their trade, experience and a trust score. The score comes from their answers to questions about their work.

statuses.title: Statuses are for you
statuses.body: New, Contacted and In conversation help you keep track. Only you see them; changing one does not message the worker.

request.title: Request details to hire
request.body: Request details sends the worker a WhatsApp message asking for the questions and documents you chose. Hired opens up once they are complete.

hired.title: Hired, then start details
hired.body: Mark them hired, then add the start day, time and place, so they know where to show up.

scenes.quote: “I finish slabs and driveways, broom and smooth, and I set my own forms.”
scenes.only_you: Only you see this status. The worker is not messaged.
scenes.wa_msg: The employer wants to hire you. Please complete your details.
scenes.sent_wa: Sent to the worker on WhatsApp

employer_messages.title: Messages
employer_messages.description: How your messages reach workers on WhatsApp.

whatsapp.title: Messages travel over WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: You write here. The worker reads and answers on WhatsApp, and their replies show up in this thread.

invitation.title: Your first message is an invitation
invitation.body: WhatsApp lets a business start a chat only with an approved invitation. The worker taps Reply and the chat opens.

reply_window.title: Then you can write freely
reply_window.body: Once the worker replies, you can write back freely. WhatsApp keeps that window open for 24 hours after their last message.

scenes.invite: An employer on Jale wants to talk to you about a Concrete finisher job.

employer.welcome_body: A quick look at where everything is. It takes less than a minute.
employer.dashboard_body: Your jobs at a glance: what is open and who applied.
employer.post_job_body: Start here. Only 4 things are required: title, trade, city and workers needed.
employer.messages_body: Write to workers here. They answer on WhatsApp, and their replies show up in the thread.
employer.applicants_body: Everyone who applied to your jobs, with their trade, experience and trust score.
employer.templates_body: Save a job you post often and reuse it.
employer.billing_body: Your plan and how many open jobs it allows.
employer.settings_body: Your company profile and account details.
employer.help_body: All guides live here. Replay any of them, or have them show every time you start a task.

worker.welcome_body: Here’s where everything is. It takes less than a minute.
worker.find_jobs_body: Jobs for your trade near you. Applying takes a minute.
worker.applications_body: Every job you applied to. You’ll see when an employer writes to you or asks for your details.
worker.profile_body: This is what employers see. Add your documents once and they’re used on every application.
worker.help_body: All guides live here. Watch any of them again whenever you want.
